title: RTT Resonance Truth Observation
description: Schema for an Observation used by the RTT Resonance Truth Service v0.1 model. An Observation represents bounded observational evidence supplied by a Source for evaluation of a Claim. An Observation is not itself a Truth State and does not determine its own qualification.

claim_id.description: Identifier of the Claim for which this Observation is being supplied as Evidence.

source_id.description: Identifier of the Source that produced or supplied this Observation.

anchor_id.description: Optional identifier of the v0.1 Anchor associated directly with this Observation. Null is valid when no qualified Anchor relationship is available or applicable.

value.description: Domain-native value represented by this Observation. The value may be scalar, structured, boolean, string, array, object, or null according to the governing domain.

observed_at.description: Timestamp associated with the underlying observation or measurement.

received_at.description: Timestamp at which the Observation was received by the evaluating or registering system.

expires_at.description: Optional explicit expiration boundary for use of this Observation. Expiration changes current qualification and does not imply that the historical Observation became false.

declared_confidence.description: Optional confidence value declared by the producing Source or upstream system. This value is Source-provided metadata and must not be treated automatically as Truth-Service qualification.

lineage_id.description: Optional reference to a canonical Lineage graph describing origin, reference, dependency, or transformation relationships associated with this Observation.

lineage.description: Optional compact inline v0.1 Lineage path retained for deterministic fixture compatibility. More complex graph-shaped Lineage should use lineage_id and the canonical Lineage schema.

integrity.description: Optional integrity information associated with this Observation. Integrity evidence does not determine the Observation's Truth qualification by itself.

registered_at.description: Timestamp at which the Observation was registered with the Truth Service or fixture environment.

metadata.description: Optional domain-specific or implementation metadata. Metadata must not override canonical Observation fields.

sequence.description: One-based position of this step in the compact v0.1 Lineage path.

entity_type.description: Type of entity represented by this inline Lineage step. This remains intentionally extensible for compatibility with domain-specific fixture data.

entity_id.description: Identifier of the entity represented by this Lineage step.

relation.description: Relationship associated with this Lineage step, such as referenced_by, observed_through, produced_by, or another domain-defined relationship.

transformation.description: Optional transformation associated with this Lineage step.

observed_at.description: Optional timestamp associated with this Lineage step.

status.description: Integrity status associated with the Observation.

method.description: Optional method used to evaluate or declare Observation integrity.

reference.description: Optional reference to a signature, digest, attestation, or other integrity artifact.

checked_at.description: Optional timestamp at which integrity was checked.

metadata.lineage_gap: No qualified reference-anchor relationship is available for this Source.
